info.answersBody: I know correctly - you know the answer. Don't know - helps you remember and adds to problematic ones. Next Word - Skips without rating.
info.extraBody: Open More options to view weekly and monthly reviews, known words, and restore hidden ones.

info.listeningBody: Click the speaker icon on the card to hear the pronunciation.
info.problemBody: Press Probl. to learn the words you got wrong. In the normal flow «I don't know» add the word here; here «I know correctly» reduces the degree of error.
info.spellingBody: Press Write to type the word by hand before answering.

info.unwantedBody: Press the crossed-out eye in the corner of the card and the word will disappear from the feed. You can return it in the Additional options section.
